diagnostico: ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE for the e-mail layout (not generated by the agent). Between 2001 and 2024, 11.2% of Petrolina shows a vegetation decline that rainfall does not explain, against 6.8% improving. Temperature rose 0.26 °C per decade since 1991, significantly, with no increase in rainfall. NISAR radar confirms the degradation mapped by MODIS (AUC 0.74), and 87.8% of the area has high or very high susceptibility.

recomendacoes.acao: Prioritize native vegetation recovery in the mapped degraded patches
recomendacoes.justificativa: The vegetation decline is concentrated in identifiable patches and coincides with significant warming and stable rainfall.
limitacoes: Satellite-based degradation does not prove desertification on the ground.

recomendacoes.acao: Track the areas where radar declines faster than typical in the next dry season
recomendacoes.justificativa: NISAR covers only the 2026 dry season; confirmation needs another cycle.

rascunho_x.texto: NASA data (NISAR, MODIS) show vegetation decline on 11% of Petrolina since 2001, with warming of 0.26 °C/decade. See the evidence and recommendations. #NISAR #Desertification
